basics.name: Danaei Katugampala
basics.label: M.A. in Economics, Old Dominion University
basics.summary: M.A. Economics student at Old Dominion University with a B.A. (Hons) in Economics. Strong background in econometrics, economic research, quantitative analysis, and data-driven problem solving, with experience using R, Stata, SPSS, and Gretl. Experienced in conducting empirical research, analyzing economic data, and communicating research findings. Interested in applying economic and analytical skills to consulting projects involving healthcare economics, public policy, and industry analysis.
